horoscopes.horoscope: Some decisions are hard to take, but a firm resolve will help you stay committed. Sentimentality may shake your purpose, but once decided, you must stick to it. Also, learn to take heartbreak in your stride, says Ganesha. You may get into a new relationship, feels Ganesha. Singles may discover new love whereas the committed people may take forward their current relationship to the next level. Expect harmony in your romantic affairs, foresees Ganesha. Your energy and spirit will keep your sweetheart happy. You will be full of energy today. Invest your time and energy in serious contemplation. You can think more seriously about things which you wish to initiate because you may be overenthusiastic today. Help others but don’t overdo it as it might drain your energy. You will be a very impulsive buyer today, feels Ganesha. You may be highly tempted to ‘pre-book’ for some online deal or you may just want to grab a deal like ‘never before and never after’. Busy and noisy activities will occupy you throughout the day. You may plan to start a new venture or take a new initiative with your colleagues in order to achieve an important project. Scheduling a meeting will be on your mind. Things will go smoothly as per your plan, feels Ganesha.

This day you will be compelled to be resigned to your fate. Ganesha does not see your own will power in operation today. Though you would be surrendering yourself to the whims of destiny, do not expect anything good to come out of it. You are likely to take wrong decisions and go of course. This is one of those days when you are liable to feel extremely lost and lonely. Have no fears. The day will pass, like any other day. A romantic rendezvous with your soul mate shall make your evening a memorable one, feels Ganesha. You are likely to look elegant and stylish in front of your sweetheart to impress him/her. Ganesha says pink will be an ideal shade for a splendid romantic evening. Keep your mind in a balanced state. This would ensure that your energy is not channelized in any wrong direction. Besides, controlling mind is also the best way to get rid of old habits. You can take strong decisions and shun bad habits. Today is not much in your favour in financial maters. You may be working on long-term financial planning. You may realise that it’s necessary to have stability and security at least in case of finances. You may rework on an old project in the first half of the day and may even change a plan after that all of a sudden. This is perhaps because you are not happy with your current responsibilities. However, it’s safer to put your mind to complete the tasks on hand.

You will try very hard to strike a balance between logic and emotions. Though you may succeed in doing so in front of the world, you may not be so discreet with your friends. You will have an excellent time with your sweetheart, but your physical appearance will be a cause of concern to you, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels this is an ideal time to get engaged as you are likely to strengthen your romantic bond with the person you love. You are likely to feel great in the arms of your sweetheart. You may be busy in planning some creative activities with your life partner. You will do more of information gathering. You may travel and wander to various places for the same reason. You will also spend energy in building and maintaining new relations. However, you should not ignore your routine tasks while doing all this. Sudden financial gains are likely today. Friends can be the source of the gain. Your enthusiasm level will also depend on how much you have in pocket. There are also indications of your desire to spend on friends. You may receive appreciation for a job well done. You will be joining a new online community and make some potential clients who will like to have a long-term relationship with you and your company. You may diplomatically handle a critical situation important for your project.

A string of domestic responsibilities awaits you; today, you are about to realise that it is a long, long string. Chances are that this sudden rise in work pressure may also lead to blood pressure problems. Ganesha advises you to stop presuming how people may react to everything; also, avoid being too proud to avoid excess heartache. Your demanding life partner will keep you tensed. Try to be diplomatic and carefully handle the matters close to the heart. You are responsible for the domestic routines. However, you may have to learn some new things from your partner you never know. So, stay updated romantically. You will invest your energy in work. Even though, multiple tasks may drain your energy, you will also have a sense of achievement. Do outdoor activities of your choice today: playing a game, or doing some gardening. Outcomes of your tasks will make you happy. Your actions will help you generate good money, feels Ganesha. At the same time, you should be ready to put in more efforts to earn more. If not today, in few months, you will surely be rewarded well. A challenging time is ahead on the professional front. You will remain occupied throughout the day and keep on juggling different tasks. Make sure that tasks will get accomplished on time effectively. You are likely to complete all the tasks for better results.

Nothing will overshadow your love for your kids today, and they will be the number one priority for you. It seems like a good day to take time out and monitor their progress in school; so, do not skip that PTA meeting. Remember, there are various ways to teach children, so consider taking them out on a small picnic or a field trip to help educate them better. Since it’s all about children today, you may also end up pampering them with goodies of their choice. Spoil them a bit, says Ganesha. After all, they are the source of your pride and joy!. Tonight you are likely to score high on passion. Ganesha foresees you tend to be intimate with your soulmate and re-energise the romantic spirit. However, you should avoid getting too much possessive as it will take a toll on his/her well-being, suggests Ganesha. It is the time to use time and energy for the right tasks. It is the time to stir up passion with some objectives. But if you get angry, you may waste your energy in the unrequired things. Remain positive about things. Today, you may feel a bit lucky about financial matters. However, it’s not an excellent day. You may enjoy ease and comforts that money can buy but don’t think of investing in risky ventures that can make you rich. Your creative spirit will be high today and you will be in a mood to coordinate in some artistic works that fascinates you. Ganesha says that you should keep in mind innovation that comes from your teammates. Managing the tasks will be challenging. You may postpone a crucial decision.

You will begin your journey on the long, hard road to success, predicts Ganesha. Hard work will be the key to any progress that you make. Avoid short cuts, and all the toil and trouble will pay off with rich returns as recognition and rewards will come your way. You may let a few opportunities fly past because of fear of taking risks. Things may not be fine in the love life with confusions obstructing your way. Misunderstanding is on the cards and it may occur due to disagreement or difference in opinions with the one you love. You should please him/her through your creative talents such as singing or dancing. You need to take proper care of your health, says Ganesha. You may feel tired even with less physical tasks. So, you should take proper sleep. You should eat health food with more vitamins and proteins. Don’t over-indulge in sexual activities. Not a very good day for money matters. You may remain concerned about finances. You may experience delay in receiving payments. You may also feel that many of your efforts to earn good money are going in vain. You will remain cool under pressure and be able to judiciously make a decision in work. You will achieve your objectives comfortably and undertake a new project. Your good relationship with colleagues give utmost satisfaction in the workplace, feels Ganesha.

Today promises a definite sense of pride and joy from children who bring home glory, says Ganesha. Fiscal gains are also on the cards, and you may consider it worthwhile to put your money into lucrative businesses. Money-lenders and stock brokers are likely to make handsome earnings on this charming and enchanting day. After a day’s busy work, you will be able to breathe fresh air once you are on the lap of your sweetheart. Satisfaction of your soulmate will be your primary concern. The moral support of your love mate will pave the way to a relaxed and intimate evening. You will have many social interactions and lot many communication with many people today. This may eat up your basic energy. This may also make you more stressed and worried. You should do activities which you like, to address this stress. Ganesha feels that it an average day for money matters. Today, you may be spending sum to please ‘others’ by and large. Savings may not increase considerably, thus may keep drawing your attention. Unfortunately, you may not enjoy a pleasant day in the workplace. Stress may keep you from meeting your deadlines. You may get fatigued or depressed after constantly doing monotonous tasks. You may have to take some critical decisions under pressure, says Ganesha.

It is more than likely that you will be in high spirits today, says Ganesha. All your energy and exuberance may not yield expected results. That is no reason to lose heart though. Keep up the effort from your end and you will eventually taste success in the days to come. You may be rigid in matters of the heart. Things may not go your way, but that does not mean that you stay away from your loved one. You should learn how to be flexible. You should actively take part in the things what your sweetheart loves, suggest Ganesha. You are likely to get tired more easily today. Even little stress will make you tired. The outcomes of tasks may not be happy for you which would make you feel a bit frustrated. Ignore things and maintain positive outlook. Ganesha advises you to keep money safe today. Chances of incurring debt would go high. The day is good if you wish to apply for loans. However, you are advised to avoid taking big loans. This is not the best day to work on a new project or take new initiatives but surely a great day to complete pending tasks. Research in your current project will keep you on your toes and you have to take apt decisions, foresees Ganesha.

You will find yourself rubbing shoulders will Lady Luck today. Sharpen your multi-tasking skills as you will keep busy and have only occasional moments of respite. Good will and green print, you might find them both with ease and in abundance, predicts Ganesha. You are in a mood to socialise with your sweetheart and family members. A fun-filled evening with your beloved is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. You may engage in fun activities with your friends and may surprise your sweetheart, says Ganesha. You will be in an excellent mood today. You may do lot many activities. As you will be overenthusiastic and very active, so will be burning lot of your energies. So, you may also eat more. However, you should take care not to overeat. It is a lucky day for money matters. You are a spendthrift and you will be highly inspired to spend money today. You may also try your luck in speculative activities. Today you will be sure about what to do, how to do and what is expected from you. Routine tasks will fill your day with action. You may apply your creativity to stay ahead in the competition. The power of your imagination will earn you many accolades.

You have sacrificed a lot on enjoyment with friends and family, done some backbreaking work and kept your focus to reach where you are right now. Ganesha gives you a pat on your back for all the hard work you’ve put in. Now, it is time to watch the tree bear fruits. With some additional responsibilities, promotion in terms of salary or position is on the cards for you. You will get so tied up in your work that you’ll crave to have free time. Your love life will flourish provided that you give him/her proper time as well as space to connect well. With things in perfect rhythm on the love front, harmony must definitely ingress. A satisfied evening is on the cards, says Ganesha. Today you should plan things on paper rather than implementing them physically. Its a good day for doing ground work on things but not executing them. Besides, you should relax and recharge yourself today. Avoid taking mental or emotional stress. Today is a good day to start your research on how to fulfill your desire to purchase a new vehicle or a new house. You will be able to direct your thinking properly to purchase long term assets. You no need to be in a hurry today. The assignments you have worked recently may actually require a bit more time to fetch expected results. The meeting, discussion, and new projects may engross you today. Planning and co-ordination will play an important part in your decision-making.

You blessed with a very high level of patience and practicality, and you can easily untangle any problem. But, it gives an excuse to the people around you to wash their hands of any responsibility. It may put you in a tight spot at times leaving you frustrated. It is not a nice feeling, agrees Ganesha, but learn to turn it your advantage, he adds. Disagreement or dispute with your partner is on the cards. Therefore, you need to keep your attitude under control. Measuring your words will hold the key to bliss. You need to get closer to your soulmate. Attention to the relationship is important for you, feels Ganesha. Your mind will be very active and you will apply logic to things. However, you should also be flexible in things. You must remain open minded. It’s also a good day to read about what’s good for your health at this age. Chances of money getting spent on short-distance trips are there. You may not be in a very enviable position on the financial front, so Ganesha advises you to first think of how to increase inflows. Today you are confident what to do and what not. You know the tactics that can stimulate better results. You are likely to take quick actions as your mood is heavy with thoughts and actions. You must finish most of your tasks today to achieve primary responsibilities.

You could swing both ways today! Fortunately, this alludes to nothing more sinister than the mix of the introvert and the extrovert that you are. So, between a quiet evening out by yourself at a classical music concert, or performing on the dance floor at the local disc — take your pick, says Ganesha. No issues are indicated in your relationship. Your love life will be smooth. You will enjoy romantic bliss with your sweetheart. Creative activities may engross your domestic life tonight. Fun time with your partner will encourage both of you to get closer to each other. While it’s not a bad day from health point of view, it’s not even excellent day for your health. Ganesha feels that you should avoid confrontation with others today, which will drain your energy faster. Try to remain happy and balanced. If you are really serious about your finances, it’s a favourable day to take advise of your chartered accountant. Today, you should try to think more positively about long term financial planning and projection. You will feel happy as your short cut techniques will save the precious time. You will handle your tasks with fantastic dexterity. Productivity and effectiveness both are likely to get improved. Ganesha feels that you will make your bosses feel more than happy.
